title: The cleanup RPC also deletes kept skips past the newest 200, so a skipped comment can be evaluated again
evidence: supabase/rls-policies.sql youtube_bot_cleanup_skipped deletes every posted=false row past the newest 200, including skips the tick means to keep (app/lib/youtube-bot.server.ts, the shouldUnclaim comment). A later tick can then claim the comment and run the model on it again. Marked rows (posted=true) are kept since C15 (US-27 AC5). The fix needs an SQL change: a larger window, or keep skips COMMENT_MAX_AGE_DAYS (C15 Q6, out of scope there)
